scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 67 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Croatian Adriatic Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 84 km this is Croatian Adriatic Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
